description.zh: 读写空间、列表与任务，创建任务、更新状态并检索文档。适合整理待办或跟进迭代。首次连接在浏览器登录 ClickUp 授权。
description.en: Read and write spaces, lists, and tasks, create tasks, update status, and search docs. Useful for tidying a backlog or following a sprint. Sign in to ClickUp in the browser on first connect.

authHint.zh: 首次连接在浏览器登录 ClickUp 并授权
authHint.en: Sign in to ClickUp and authorize on first connect
